summary: P01 V2.47.122 Navigation mature bookmark-library frame. Reframes desktop Navigation as one coherent mature product surface: compact one-column collection rail, quieter scope control, tighter category hierarchy, and a unified collection header combining title/count/sort/select. Removes the dashboard-like 2x2 rail and oversized dead header space. Locked Navigation IA, bookmark-row semantics, Shared Shell, Home, Channels and all other surfaces remain unchanged. No schema, data, auth mechanism, updater, provider, server, or Production write.
